If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over last 5 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤-0.33) over last 5 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment swings sharply (alternating 0.33/1.00) in last 3 days, apply a 0.5–1.0% downward correction to forecast at 16–28 days to dampen volatility.  
If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and forecast is trending upward, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon (29–30 days) to prevent overcorrection.  
If sentiment is positive but forecast is trending downward, apply a 0.5–1.0% upward correction to forecast at 1–7 days to align with sentiment momentum.  
If sentiment is negative but forecast is trending upward, apply a 0.5–1.0% downward correction to forecast at 8–15 days to prevent sentiment mismatch.
